name: Pfizer Ltd
about:
Pfizer Ltd is engaged in manufacturing, marketing, trading and export of pharmaceutical products. It manufactures products through its own facility and also has various independent contract/ third party manufacturers based across the country and sells its products through independent distributors primarily in India.[1]
It is the 3rd largest multinational pharmaceutical company in India.[2]
keyPoints:
Parentage
The company is a subsidiary of Pfizer Inc. one of the world’s leading biopharma companies with a presence in over 125 countries. Pfizer develops and produces medicines and vaccines for immunology, oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, and neurology. [1] [2]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 59.6%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.18% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.369 Cr.
